items.title: Goals and research
items.text: I gather materials, logins, goals and competitors, and study what your customers search for on Google before anything gets decided.

items.title: Site structure
items.text: Pages, user journeys and content mapped out before the design, so visitors find what they need straight away.

items.title: Copy that sells
items.text: I write the copy in the words your customers use and Google rewards. You sign it off before it goes live.

items.title: Custom design
items.text: Designed for desktop, tablet and phone. No templates: the website tells your story, not someone else’s.

items.title: Clean code
items.text: WordPress when you want to run it yourself, custom builds when you need top speed. Never bloated page builders.

items.title: Technical SEO and AI visibility
items.text: Titles, descriptions, structured data, sitemap and local SEO. Clear content that ChatGPT, Gemini and Perplexity can read and quote, too.

items.title: Speed and Core Web Vitals
items.text: Optimized images, lean code, fonts that load properly. Every page is tested with Lighthouse before handover.

items.title: Tracking from day one
items.text: Google Analytics 4, Tag Manager, Search Console and Consent Mode set up, so you know how many enquiries come in and where from.

items.title: Accessible, secure and compliant
items.text: Meets the European Accessibility Act, with HTTPS, security headers, and privacy and cookies sorted.

items.title: Training, handover and… it’s yours
items.text: I show you how to update the website yourself. Domain, logins and code are in your name: no lock-in, ever.

quality.title: Don’t take my word for it: check for yourself
quality.text: Every website is handed over after a test with **Google Lighthouse**, the free tool anyone can use to measure a page’s speed, accessibility, technical quality and SEO. I aim for 100 in all four.

faq.title: Questions about websites
faq.text: Can’t see yours? [Drop me a line](#contatti) and I’ll reply by the next business day.

items.question: How much does a website cost?
items.answer: It depends on the number of pages, features, languages and content. After the free call you get a **fixed-price** quote covering everything on this page: no hidden costs, no extra hours.

items.question: How long does it take?
items.answer: Mostly it depends on the size of the website and how quickly things get signed off. The quote gives you a date for each stage and for launch, and I stick to them.

items.question: Can I update the website myself?
items.answer: Yes. Training is included: I’ll show you how to edit text, images and pages. Rather not deal with it? I can handle it for you with a support plan.

items.question: I already have a website: will I lose my Google rankings?
items.answer: Not if the migration is done right. Before launch I map every existing page and set up redirects, so Google and your visitors land on the new addresses straight away.

items.question: What technology do you use?
items.answer: Whatever’s right for you. WordPress if you want to manage the content yourself, custom builds when speed and security come first. Either way, no bloated page builders slowing the website down.

items.question: Can you help with copy and photos too?
items.answer: I write the copy myself, after a chat with you. For photos I’ll tell you what’s needed and, if you like, put you in touch with photographers I trust; otherwise I use high-quality stock images.

items.question: Will the website really be mine?
items.answer: Yes: domain, hosting, code and accounts (Google, Analytics) are all in your name. You can switch providers whenever you like, no strings attached.
